facts.business: Neelkanth Limited (formerly R.T. Exports Limited) operates in the rice and agricultural sector, focusing on rice production, processing, and trading, benefiting from India's position as the world's largest rice producer.
key_risks: Dependence on monsoon rainfall for agricultural production
Climate change impacts including delayed monsoons, heat stress, and water scarcity
Fluctuations in global rice prices and trade policies
Regulatory changes in agricultural and seed sectors
